messages:
kai: FYI canary for search-api v3.4 rolled, but query-latency SLO breached on canary cohort (p95 +40%).
deploy-bot: Canary health check: performance-regression (p95 latency delta > 25%). Canary paused automatically per perf-gate. Metric window: 5m.
marta: which change introduced in this chart? Chart diff shows `timeout-ms` decreased from 1200 -> 800 and new http client lib.
engr-lead: that config tweak was intentional for retry behaviour. Could it be increasing tail latency?
kai: traces show extra retries to upstream, causing queueing on canary pods. Logs: `upstream timeout, retrying (attempt 2)`.
release-manager: two options: 1) rollback chart+image to stable (safe), 2) revert timeout change and re-run canary quickly (faster). Need decision aligned w/ risk window.
infra-oncall: if we rollback, note that the older sidecar image lacks a bugfix for connection pool leak. Tradeoffs both ways.
marta: leaning revert of config to avoid losing critical sidecar leak fix. We can patch values and run a limited canary (20%).
engr-lead: agree with limited canary patch. Also add circuit-breaker on upstream calls to cap retries during canary.
kai: ok I'll apply a canary-only values patch and set `release.redwood.io/canary-fraction=0.2` on the HelmRelease then unpause. Command:
```
kubectl -n prod annotate helmrelease search-api \
  release.redwood.io/canary-fraction=0.2 --overwrite
helm upgrade --install search-api ./charts/search \
  --set timeoutMs=1200 --set upstream.circuitBreaker=true
```
release-manager: I'll update release notes with: "Canary paused due to latency regression; temporary revert of timeout and circuit-breaker enabled for limited canary while we verify upstream retry behavior."
deploy-bot: annotation applied. Canary fraction set to 20%. Re-running canary per manual override. Monitoring window 30m.
kai: new canary pods are up, initial p95 back to baseline at 2m sample. Will monitor for full 30m.
release-manager: creating follow-up ticket RDW-501 to revisit timeout and upstream retry semantics; PROD change freeze until postmortem closes if regression recur.
engr-lead: capture traces and add to ticket. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
